tasks.subject: Read backend spec rules
tasks.description: Read all .trellis/spec/backend/*.md and shared/*.md files to understand the project's mandatory quality rules before reviewing code.

tasks.subject: Review database package
tasks.description: Read and review every file in packages/database/src/**, drizzle.config.ts, package.json, tsconfig.json. Schema, queries, client, env, seed.

tasks.subject: Review auth package
tasks.description: Read and review every file in packages/auth/src/**. auth.ts, client.ts, bootstrap-admin, session-cache, smtp, index.

tasks.subject: Review api package
tasks.description: Read and review every file in packages/api/src/**. orpc router/middleware/procedures, all modules (admin, channels, health, history, products, settings), shared, index.

tasks.subject: Compile review report
tasks.description: Aggregate findings grouped by severity, strengths, and rule-compliance spot check table. Return structured report.
